LightningComponentBundle.description: Uploads images like the standard File Upload component, compressing them first as configured in Image Compression Settings.

property.name: label
property.label: Label
property.description: Text above the file selector. Defaults to "Upload Images".

property.name: accept
property.label: Accepted File Types
property.description: Comma-separated extensions, e.g. .jpg,.png. Can only narrow the supported types (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, .gif). Defaults to .jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp.
